versions.changelog:
- Expanded the list of recommended specialized datasets to include new embodied AI and robotics benchmarks (e.g., GaussianGrasper, GraspSplats, ManiGaussian, RoboSplat, VR-Robo, GSMem).
- Added coverage for embodied AI evaluation scenarios such as grasping, manipulation, navigation, and spatial memory.
- No other changes outside the dataset recommendation section.

- Summary: Streamlined documentation with minor rewording and formatting improvements.

- Shortened the description for clarity and conciseness.
- Reformatted the tags into a single-line array.
- Removed the YAML "trigger" block from the header.
- No functional changes to workflow, datasets, or experiment design advice.
- Content and recommendations remain the same; only documentation structure and wording improved.

Expanded and updated specialized benchmark and baseline guidance for state-of-the-art 3D Gaussian Splatting experiments.

- Added new datasets and benchmarks for emerging 3DGS research subfields, including temporal, medical, security, and cross-domain applications.
- Updated the baseline comparison section with recent and specialized 3DGS methods relevant to various categories such as compression, geometry, editing, optimization, and robustness.
- Improved organization and completeness of suggested datasets, methods, and baseline tiers to reflect the latest literature and reviewer expectations.
- Version number updated to reflect these content and structural enhancements.

- No functional or content changes in this version.
- Internal version or metadata update only; all features and documentation remain the same.

Initial release of 3dgs-experiment-planner—your expert guide for rigorous 3D Gaussian Splatting experiment design.

- Recommends datasets and baselines tailored to your method and claims.
- Provides detailed matrices for ablation studies with clear design principles.
- Suggests evaluation metrics and visualization plans aligned with top computer vision venues.
- Addresses common reviewer concerns and workflow for experiment design.
- Supports both English and Chinese triggers for experiment planning.
